text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
K.S.Miracle's recovery is going well. The 
Trainer is overjoyed to see her running 
again, praying that she stays healthy 
forever.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just seeing her start running again, just 
seeing her spiritedly dashing across the 
turf— the Trainer stated that alone was 
more than enough.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her supporting family and competing rivals 
all felt the same. With that kindness as 
her strength, KS Miracle ran the Swan 
Stakes.
